devdoc.details: Basic arbitrator contract for Reality.eth integration

params._arbitrationFee: Fixed (And minimal) fee for arbitration services

getDisputeFee(bytes32).details: Returns the dispute fee for a given question

isArbitrationPending(bytes32).details: Check if arbitration is pending for a question

params.lastSeenBond: The last seen bond (not used in this simple implementation)
params.question_id: The ID of the question to arbitrate

submitArbitrationAnswer(bytes32,bytes32,.details: Submit arbitration decision (owner only for MVP)

params.answerer: The address to receive the reward (usually the requester)

submitArbitrationAnswerWithWinner(bytes3.details: Enhanced arbitration submission with winner assignment (v2.1+)

params.payee_if_wrong: Address to receive payout if the final answer was wrong
